argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Reductio ad absurdum via immanent critique

argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Moderate to high within pragmatist framework

distinctions_drawn: Demand satisfaction vs. tolerance as meta-demand
explicit_definitions_given: Tolerance = meta-demand requiring acceptance of all demands

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Tolerance objection is raised and answered
objections_raised: Tolerance as a standard of adjudication

summary_of_core_decisions: The text is a tightly structured immanent critique of Jamesian pragmatism. It defines James's moral criterion as demand satisfaction, exposes its inability to adjudicate conflicting demands, considers tolerance as a rescue, and shows that tolerance is self-defeating. The conclusion is that Jamesian pluralism collapses into arbitrariness, validating the incoherence charge.
